column4: nice-dns install puts ~/Applications/nice-dns.app on the Mac, signed and without quarantine; --check exits 0 naming the generation

NiceDNSGUI --run-action restart --exit returns 0 and DNS answers
NiceDNSGUI --run-action bridges-off then bridges-on each return 0 with DNS answering after

nice-dns install after the uninstall puts the app and the stack back
